g.text: The cap or the model sets borrowing. Not price.
Aug-Nov 2025. Low close -31.4% on day 85. The -41% wick was under one hour and missed by the hourly oracle.
Borrowed day 30, $ thousands. Blue/purple Laya. Red Jev.
Borrow offered: Laya took it 54/54, 292/295 and 258/260 times. Jev took it 2/219 and 2/218. A 2.5x rate change barely moved either. Do not estimate elasticity from this.
Protocol share vs $20,000 campaign spend, dollars
